description: The single roster of record for AI reviewers. `ai-review-preflight usable <provider>` is the only supported answer to "can I use this reviewer right now"; it combines this roster with the live quarantine and live-qualification state. Nothing else may keep a second reviewer roster.

eligibility_values.active: may receive new review work, subject to preflight quarantine and live qualification
eligibility_values.historical-only: withdrawn by owner instruction; may not receive new work regardless of local health

qwen.note: The 2026-08-28 retirement was withdrawn by owner instruction on 2026-09-04 (popcre/ai-devops#286); requires ai-review-preflight qualify qwen.
